scope: Source-verified game recompilation discoveries from round 12. All development status statements are attributed to the maintainers; external media is represented by URLs only.

projects.title: SSX 3 (Xbox PAL) Static Recompilation for Windows
projects.platform: Original Xbox (PAL) → Windows x86-64 (native; Vulkan-rendered Xbox GPU)
projects.status: No public release listed. The maintainer README reports the whole game playable, including races/freestyle events across all three peaks, Conquer the Mountain and two-player split-screen; it also reports a two-hour soak test and 48/48 scripted boots reaching a race. These are maintainer-reported results, not independent verification.
projects.summary: Static recompilation of the PAL Xbox build to native x86-64 code with an Xbox GPU renderer using Vulkan. The repo contains original tooling and project code only; a user-supplied disc rip is required and derived game code is regenerated locally.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; game data is user-supplied and not distributed

projects.title: Rollcage Stage II PlayStation Static Recompilation
projects.platform: PlayStation (USA, SLUS-00867) → Windows x64; Linux x86-64 and macOS packages are produced by CI, but native setup and gameplay are not verified
projects.status: v0.1.0 release candidate. The exact Windows setup package passes maintainer-reported clean-extract setup and headless start; a private build was reported playable at the maintainer’s September 12, 2026 operator tally. Linux and macOS packages are generated by CI, but their native setup and gameplay remain unverified. Requires the user’s own disc image and SCPH-1001 BIOS.
projects.summary: Owned-input PS1 static-recompilation setup kit based on psxrecomp and recomp-ui. It generates and compiles the title locally; the repository and releases do not include the disc, BIOS, derived game code, or saves.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; game data is user-supplied and not distributed

projects.title: SpaceRanger — Toy Story 2 N64 Static Recompilation
projects.game: Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue (Nintendo 64, USA)
projects.platform: Nintendo 64 (USA) → Windows x64 (Direct3D 12 / Shader Model 6 or Vulkan 1.2)
projects.status: Early pre-release v0.1.0. The maintainer README says the game is playable from start to finish; it also lists rough edges, including particle interpolation and sound issues, and says frame pacing has mostly been tested on one PC. The user supplies the original USA N64 ROM.
projects.summary: Native Windows port that statically recompiles the N64 title using N64: Recompiled and renders through RT64. Releases contain no game assets; the original user-owned ROM is used locally.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; game data is user-supplied and not distributed

projects.title: The Darkness VR — Independent Static-Recompilation Research
projects.platform: Xbox 360 → PC (host operating system unspecified); stereo VR is experimental and not yet connected to a headset
projects.status: Experimental and unfinished. The project README reports that its own PC recompilation runs in real-time 3D and that one test displayed the same moment in left/right stereo views (reported by the maintainer for 2026-10-12). Headset integration is a next step; this is not a supported product. This is a separate in-house implementation, not the already-catalogued community Windows port.
projects.summary: Independent Xbox 360 recompilation research whose stated goal is a VR version. The maintainer says the project uses its own copy of the game and the open ReXGlue toolkit; the repo includes research notes and tooling but no original game content.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; game data is user-supplied and not distributed

projects.title: CryRecomp — Tears of the Kingdom Static-Recompilation Research
projects.game: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
projects.platform: Nintendo Switch (AArch64 modules) → native AArch64 output (code generation/runtime target planned; host OS unspecified)
projects.status: Experimental research; explicitly not a playable port. The README reports that retail modules are parsed and linked, a measured relocation batch is applied, and recompiled code reaches nnMain. Fixed-base code generation and Horizon IPC bring-up remain active; native AArch64 code generation and application runtime are listed as planned.
projects.summary: Game-specific static-recompilation research for Tears of the Kingdom. The repository says it distributes no Nintendo code, game assets, console keys, copyrighted game data, or download URLs; users provide local input.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; game data is user-supplied and not distributed

projects.title: Toy Story 2 PlayStation Native/Dynamic-Recompilation Port
projects.game: Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue! (PlayStation, USA SLUS_008.93)
projects.platform: PlayStation (USA SLUS_008.93) → Linux x86-64 (Lightrec dynamic-recomp executor plus title-owned native subsystems)
projects.status: Work in progress. The maintainer README reports the Linux x86-64 product runs the title, menu, level select, LEVEL01 and Andy’s Room through psxport’s Lightrec runtime executor. Native scene producers and true widescreen for the front end remain incomplete. The repository has no offline guest source or player-selectable interpreter path; its asset-free verification gate does not establish gameplay compatibility.
projects.summary: A title-specific native port for the USA PlayStation build. It combines title-owned native subsystems with psxport’s maintained Lightrec dynamic-recompilation executor; user supplies the original disc image, and no game content is tracked or packaged.
projects.strategy: Runtime dynamic recompilation through Lightrec, with title-owned native subsystems; no static guest-source decompilation
projects.source_available: Public source repository; game data is user-supplied and not distributed
